sources.title: Schematron V2 Small | AI Models | Inference.net
sources.evidence: Exact model page lists InferenceNet as developer and 3B parameters. Its embedded page state identifies inference-net/schematron-v2-small with contextSize:128000 and capabilities tools:false, structuredOutputs:true, imageInput:false, reasoning:false. Visible context renders as 125K. Freshly reopened October 27: the exact model page still explicitly reports Size 3B parameters, with no separately labeled active count or named base.

sources.title: Schematron V2: Frontier HTML-to-JSON extraction at a fraction of the cost
sources.evidence: April 16, 2026 announcement explicitly releases V2 Small and V2 Turbo that day. It says their weights remain closed-source and API-exclusive, while the earlier 3B and 8B remain open. It does not identify V2 Small architecture or active parameters. Fresh October 27 reread confirms the pricing section explicitly calls the model V2 3B, independently of the introduction’s 3B-like speed comparison. Neither its original benchmark tables nor its fine-tuning-platform description names a base model or active count.

sources.title: Schematron - Inference.net Documentation
sources.evidence: Defines the Schematron family as schema-guided HTML-to-JSON extraction models. V2 Small accepts extraction instructions through JSON Schema. Identifies legacy Schematron-8B calls as redirected to V2 Small; this does not make their checkpoints identical. Freshly reread October 27. The explicit legacy-8B-to-V2-Small API routing is a replacement relationship, not unchanged checkpoint or architecture lineage.

sources.title: Inference.net public model API
sources.evidence: Live HTTP 200 response for inference-net/schematron-v2-small returns context_length 128000, max_completion_tokens 4096, input_modalities [text], and output_modalities [text]. Retrieved with curl after Python/web fetches failed. Fresh October 27 HTTP 200 retrieval confirms the exact model entry still has no total, active or base-model field. The separately published 3B total is retained from the developer product page.

sources.title: Use Inference.net Models in Coding Agents
sources.evidence: Explicitly excludes inference-net/schematron-* extraction models from tool-call support. Describes the public model API fields.

sources.title: Best LLM for Data Extraction: Schematron Quality Metrics for HTML, Tables, and Noisy Pages
sources.evidence: June 16, 2026 comparison names V2 Small separately from V2 Turbo and both V1 sizes; describes reasoning/synthesis as outside the task-specific extraction model scope. No architecture or active-count disclosure. Fresh full October 27 reread found no parameter-count, active-count or named-base declaration for V2 Small.

sources.title: Hybrid-Attention models are the future for SLMs
sources.evidence: November 3, 2025 training research discusses an HTML-to-JSON project using Nemotron Nano v2 hybrid architecture, but never identifies Schematron V2 Small. It cannot establish this exact model architecture. Freshly reopened October 27: the discussed 12B-to-9B pruning/distillation and hybrid layer pattern concern Nemotron Nano v2, with no explicit mapping to V2 Small.

sources.title: How Inference.net trains Specialized Language Models that cut AI costs by up to 50x
sources.evidence: March 11, 2026 training research covers a specialized 9B Nemotron deployment and OSSAS-Nemotron-12B. It does not mention Schematron or identify V2 Small. Fresh full October 27 reread likewise contains no exact Schematron V2 Small identity or transferable base declaration.

sources.title: inference-net/Schematron-3B model card
sources.evidence: The first-generation 3B card identifies Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct and llama3.2 licensing. These are V1 disclosures and must not be transferred to V2 Small. Fresh raw README retrieval October 27 reconfirms base_model: meta-llama/Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct for this original V1 repository only.

sources.title: Circulated V2 checkpoint identifier (inaccessible)
sources.evidence: A third-party listing pointed to this identifier. The page and Hugging Face model API returned HTTP 401, so no model card, configuration or tensor metadata could be verified. Its name alone does not establish architecture, licensing or open weights. Rechecked October 27: both the exact raw README and Hugging Face model API still return HTTP 401. No inaccessible content or inferred checkpoint structure is claimed.

sources.title: UltraBERT extraction model: original Schematron V2 Small comparison
sources.evidence: Freshly read the full raw original model card October 27. Its LocalLLaMA/typed-extraction comparison names Schematron V2 Small and supplies task scores, but no total/activated-count row for Schematron. The separate Params table contains only encoder baselines; its sizes cannot be assigned to Schematron.

sources.title: Original typed-extraction benchmark and exact V2 Small baseline
sources.evidence: Fresh full raw dataset-card read October 27. Links the exact Schematron V2 Small endpoint and reports original extraction results. It provides no Schematron active-parameter convention, architecture or named-base evidence.

sources.title: Puter serving documentation: uncorroborated Llama base claim
sources.evidence: Fresh exact-model lead states that V2 Small is fine-tuned from Llama 3.2 3B, but offers no original developer attribution or accessible checkpoint evidence for the relationship. It also presents the September 12 provider listing as the release date despite Inference.net’s April launch. Kept as an investigated secondary architecture lead, not a verified developer lineage declaration or active-count disclosure.

sources.title: OpenRouter exact model metadata
sources.evidence: Fresh HTTP 200 JSON read October 27. Description repeats 3B total; architecture reports tokenizer Other and text modalities, with no named-base statement or active count. Circulated repository-name strings do not by themselves verify unchanged Llama lineage.

developer.note: Developer brand; page also spells it InferenceNet.

family.note: Normalized lowercase key for the explicitly named Schematron extraction-model family.

release_date.note: Dated first-party launch says both V2 models are available that day. September provider listings are later distribution dates.

open_weights.note: Explicit closed-weight release; accessible legacy checkpoints belong to V1. The inaccessible circulated V2 repository is not evidence of distributed weights.

license.note: Descriptive classification for closed-source, API-exclusive V2 weights; no open license is verified.

parameters_b.note: October 27 re-audit freshly confirms the developer’s nominal 3B total on the exact product page and the explicit V2 3B launch-pricing label. This is a published nominal specification, not a count inferred from throughput or an exact tensor census. No more precise original count was found.

active_parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 exact-name/ID total, active, activated, later original-comparison and named-base searches found no supported separate active count. Reopened current developer product/launch/docs/API, later developer comparison and training research, and original UltraBERT/typed-extraction comparisons. These supply no V2 Small active convention. V1’s Llama parent and API replacement routing do not establish unchanged V2 lineage. Puter’s uncited Llama fine-tune prose remains uncorroborated by the developer, and the circulated V2 card/API is still inaccessible. Keep null rather than copying 3B total or importing a speculative base count.

architecture.note: Exact-model sources omit architecture. Reviewed later comparison and training research do not connect a disclosed architecture to V2 Small. V1 Llama and unrelated Nemotron disclosures cannot be transferred; no accessible V2 checkpoint was found to inspect.

context_window.note: Exact live API count and embedded product state agree; visible 125K is the page display, not a conflicting 125000-token limit.

reasoning.note: Exact product page capability state explicitly sets reasoning:false; this concerns the exposed reasoning feature.

tool_call.note: Exact product capability state and explicit Schematron exception agree.

description.value: Schema-guided HTML-to-JSON extraction model for complex schemas and long web pages.
description.note: Replaces unsupported general assistance and routine-automation positioning with the documented specialized task.

patch.description: Schema-guided HTML-to-JSON extraction model for complex schemas and long web pages.
patch.notes: Inference.net reports a nominal 3B total. No separate active count or architecture was found in the checked primary sources. Legacy V1 checkpoints and replacement API routing do not establish an unchanged V2 base.

summary: October 27 parameter re-audit retains the developer-published nominal 3B total and explicitly retains active_parameters_b=null after fresh original-source, later-comparison and named-base searches. Investigated the uncited Llama lineage lead without treating the inaccessible V2 repository or legacy routing as proof. All twelve nonparameter assessments and earlier corrections are preserved. No weights were downloaded.
